result.reason: The redline provides 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day Customer opt-out, and a 60-day Vendor reminder, thereby reaching most of the preferred renewal mechanics. However, it includes no cap on renewal price increases—neither the preferred lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap nor the fallback 5% cap—so it does not fully satisfy the playbook. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although the original 90-day termination language remains applicable to HDI and could be clarified as a non-renewal right rather than termination.
